features: Intelligent Tracking using built-in Intelligent Video Analytics (IVA)
Quad streaming: two H.264 4CIF/D1 streams, one H.264 I-frame-only stream, one M-JPEG stream
Wide Dynamic Range 92 dB (50 dB with WDR off)
Day/night with SensUp; Sodium Vapor White Balance
Pan 360 deg continuous; preset speed pan 360 deg/s, tilt 100 deg/s
99 pre-positions, preset tour and two recorded tours
Optional fiber optic Ethernet media converter kit (VG4-SFPSCKT)
Pendant housing with sunshield, clear acrylic bubble (NEMA 4X except impact test with acrylic bubble); convertible to indoor pendant by removing the sunshield

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.

release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (autodome_700_data_sheet_enus_9007201732739723.pdf, Wayback copy), 36x Day/Night column and Pendant column. VG5-714-ECE2 = PAL, VG5-724-ECE2 = NTSC (36x IP pendant, clear acrylic bubble, with IVA). Sensitivity: min_lux_color = day mode 30 IRE SensUp off (0.66 lux), min_lux = night mode 30 IRE SensUp off (0.104 lux). Power is 24 VAC only per this datasheet (no PoE listed); 60 W / 69 VA typical with heater (24 W without heater, indoor use, then -10 to 40 C). Weight is the outdoor pendant figure (indoor pendant 2.88 kg). RTSP config uses Bosch's standard ?inst= scheme and is not bench-tested on this legacy SD model.
